news.title: In Cleveland return, LeBron James struggles to find 'good rhythm' in 76ers' loss
news.text: Returning to Cleveland as the opposition for the third time in a different NBA uniform, LeBron James struggled against the Cavaliers, finishing with eight points on 3-for-12 shooting with six turnovers in Philadelphia's 119-96 NBA Cup loss.
